forbidden.comment: An App Router page, layout, route handler, template or boundary file is an entry Next.js loads by its path; importing one from another module runs it outside its route and couples two routes. plan:rulebearing-nextjs
forbidden.fix: Move what both need into a module outside app/ (components/ or lib/) and import that from the route file and from here.
forbidden.name: nextjs-no-import-of-route-entries

forbidden.comment: A file under pages/api/ or app/api/ is an HTTP handler; importing it from a page or a component calls the handler's module in the wrong runtime and ties the UI to the transport. plan:rulebearing-nextjs
forbidden.fix: Move the logic the handler and the caller share into a server module (server/ or lib/), import that from both, and call the API over HTTP from the browser.
forbidden.name: nextjs-no-import-of-api-routes

forbidden.comment: components/, hooks/ and lib/ are shared by every route; one that imports from app/ or pages/ makes every route depend on that one. plan:rulebearing-nextjs
forbidden.fix: Move the code the shared module needs out of the route folder into components/, hooks/ or lib/, or pass it in as a prop or an argument.
forbidden.name: nextjs-shared-code-not-to-routes

forbidden.comment: A component can be bundled for the browser; importing from server/ ships server code (database clients, secrets) to it or fails the build. plan:rulebearing-nextjs
forbidden.fix: Fetch the data in a server component, getServerSideProps or a route handler and pass it to the component as props; move types the component needs out of server/.
forbidden.name: nextjs-components-not-to-server
